title: Coconut Says Tok Tok | Manipuri Kids Song & Rhymes | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
A cheerful Manipuri nursery rhyme about a little coconut that goes tok tok and makes the whole garden giggle.
Follow the playful tune and sing along with your little one.
Every rhyme teaches new words, counting, and the joy of music.

Tok tok!

Coconut, coconut, sweet little coconut, what do you say?
Tok tok, tok tok, the coconut is knocking today!
Tok tok, tok tok, tok tok, tok!
Naughty little tok tok, the monkey runs away.
